annotations.title: Remove a rank tracker chart note

description: Removes a chart note from a rank tracker's own timeline. FREE: database only, no SEO data provider is called and no credits are spent. Succeeds whether or not `id` matched an existing note.

configId.description: Rank tracker config ID. Call get_rank_tracker without a trackerId to list the project's trackers and their IDs.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: remove_rank_annotation
